PluginEditTool/native/tests/unit/Radicle.reason: One cohesive gtest translation unit for the QUST authoring backend, already over the 1000-line limit before this change. Nomad's decision is not to split it, so its growth is carried here rather than by breaking the suite into arbitrary line-count chunks. The file is hand-written tests only: each TEST_CASE exercises one authoring path (aliases, stages, objectives, conditions, VMAD rewrite) and shares the fixtures at the top, so a split would need a shared test-support header first; that split is a follow-up, not a blocker for adding a case.
